run_omol_calculations: run OMolRunner calculate method to perform energy and force calculations on a subset of molecular structures
write_omol_results: write OMolRunner calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the specified results directory
initialize_omol_runner: initialize an OMolRunner with an ASE calculator, pickled input data, benchmark name, and benchmark function
review_omol_runner_class: review the OMolRunner class and its calculate method for parallel job splitting using numpy array_split
save_omol_checkpoint: save the OMolRunner state to a checkpoint location for preemption handling
